nl_request: Find the facility tickets for buildings located in Duskwater, opened on or after 2025-03-11 and before 2025-08-26, with a priority of at least 2 and with no resolution date recorded. Return the IDs of the matching facility tickets.
reference_sql:
SELECT t.id
FROM facility_tickets AS t
JOIN buildings AS b ON b.id = t.building_id
WHERE b.city = 'Duskwater'
  AND t.opened_at >= '2025-03-11' AND t.opened_at < '2025-08-26'
  AND t.priority >= 2
  AND t.resolved_at IS NULL
ORDER BY t.id
